patches.rationale: The original merge_config performs a shallow dict update, so nested mappings are not merged and nested objects are shared with the inputs. The issue requires a recursive merge where overrides win at leaves, lists are replaced (not concatenated), and the returned structure is independent of both inputs (no shared nested objects, no mutation of inputs). I implement a recursive helper that builds fresh dicts at every level, copies list values into new lists, and leaves other leaf values as-is. The existing simple-override behavior is preserved. New regression tests in a fresh file cover nested merge, leaf override, list replacement, input non-mutation, and output independence.

edits.old:
def merge_config(defaults, overrides):
    result = dict(defaults)
    result.update(overrides)
    return result

contract_tests: test_simple_override_preserved: merge_config({"a": 1}, {"a": 2, "b": 3}) == {"a": 2, "b": 3} and merge_config({}, {}) == {} (preserves original simple-override semantics).

test_nested_mappings_are_merged_recursively: merge_config({"db": {"host": "localhost", "port": 5432, "opts": {"ssl": False}}}, {"db": {"port": 6543, "opts": {"ssl": True}}}) == {"db": {"host": "localhost", "port": 6543, "opts": {"ssl": True}}}; result and nested values are dict instances.
test_override_wins_at_leaves: merge_config({"a": {"b": {"c": 1, "d": 2}}}, {"a": {"b": {"c": 99}}}) == {"a": {"b": {"c": 99, "d": 2}}} (override leaf wins, non-overridden leaf preserved).

test_lists_are_replaced_not_concatenated: merge_config({"items": [1, 2, 3], "nested": {"items": ["a"]}}, {"items": [4], "nested": {"items": ["b", "c"]}}) == {"items": [4], "nested": {"items": ["b", "c"]}}; list values are list instances.
test_inputs_are_not_mutated: after merge_config(defaults, overrides), defaults and overrides equal their pre-call snapshots (no mutation of either input).
test_result_is_independent_of_inputs: result nested dicts and lists are not identical objects to any input nested dict/list; mutating result nested values does not change defaults or overrides.
test_new_keys_from_overrides_are_independent: keys present only in overrides are deep-copied into result so result nested dicts/lists are not shared with overrides.
